items.expected: Specify composition, charge, electronic state, energy definition and structural status for every comparison. Electronic-character claims require appropriate wavefunction or density evidence. A converged calculation is not automatically a stable state; collapsed starts count as evidence about the search, not separate states.

Build a quantitative, internally comparable picture of electronic character for the bounded four models. Identify state stability and the meaning of each energy difference without demanding a particular CS/BS/T enumeration.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Explain topology/substituent dependence using evidence with discriminating ability. Aromaticity, occupation, spin or other justified diagnostics are acceptable when definitions and applicability are explicit; no named descriptor is compulsory.

Assess electronic-method, structural and state-identification uncertainty relevant to the proposed ordering. Distinguish electronic, zero-point-corrected and free energies; genuine collapse or unresolved near-degeneracy must be evidenced.
